paragraphs: R. Chiyya bar Mira and R. Yonah. Jerusalem Sheviit, chapter 6, end of halakhah 1, has bar Madya before R. Yosi; also the end of Yom Tov. Bar Mariya and R. Yonah; R. Ba bar Chiyya in R. Yochanan's name: Sanhedrin, chapter 1, halakhah 2. Bar Mariya; R. Yonah; R. Zeira; R. Ba bar Zutra; R. Chanina in Rabbi's name: Avodah Zarah, chapter 2, halakhah 2, and Shemonah Sheratzim, halakhah 4. He asked before R. Yonah: Ketubot, chapter 9, halakhah 1.
